description: This file contains core repository functions for managing certification jobs, including creating, retrieving, patching, listing mappings and metadata, upserting metadata, and updating job statuses based on external webhook signals. It primarily interacts with SQLAlchemy ORM models and asynchronous database sessions.

methods.name: CertificationJob create_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, req: TriggerCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Creates a new certification job, attempts to resolve repository info via adapter, and initializes associated result entries.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] get_certification_job_by_run_id(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a certification job by its unique run identifier.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] patch_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, patch: PatchCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Applies partial updates to a certification job based on provided patch data.

methods.name: List[BranchEnvironmentMapping] list_mappings(session: AsyncSession, provider: Optional[str] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists branch-environment mappings with optional filtering by provider and project_id.

methods.name: BranchEnvironmentMapping create_mapping(session: AsyncSession, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new branch-environment mapping record.

methods.name: List[MetadataItem] list_metadata(session: AsyncSession, filters: Dict[str, Optional[str]])
methods.description: Retrieves metadata items with optional filtering by provider, project_id, branch, and key.

methods.name: MetadataItem upsert_metadata(session: AsyncSession, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates or updates a metadata item based on identifying fields.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] update_result_state_by_webhook(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, cert_type: Optional[CertificationType], state: str, logs_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates certification results based on webhook input, adjusting statuses, and invoking orchestration refresh.
